text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Haru Urara hears that the folks 
from the shopping district are forming a 
"fan club" for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara didn't really understand what a 
"fan club" was, but she was overjoyed to 
hear that so many people would be cheering 
for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The more fans who support her, the more 
strength Haru Urara gains.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sensing this, the Trainer resolved to keep 
entering her in races while steadily 
growing her fanbase.
